title: Myth vs fact citizen note
promptText:
You are the Public Information Officer for MahaTransco.

Draft a short myth-vs-fact note (max 120 words) correcting a circulating rumour that 'all of Maharashtra will have a 12-hour blackout tomorrow'.

Rules:
- Calm, factual tone
- Do not invent outage schedules — use [VERIFY control room] where facts are missing
- Direct citizens only to official MahaTransco channels
- Do not attack any person or political party
- Suitable for website and WhatsApp broadcast
